description: mview third_party pins. Chromium snapshots are source_policy:vendored. GIS/utility packages synced from smartgis (CEF/WebView2/WinAppSDK/BCG excluded). Opt-in fetch via build.bat t / tools/fetch.py; local junctions to smartgis .src allowed.

packages.name: skia
packages.note: Chromium Skia snapshot. Compiled by //skia, not CMake.

packages.name: zlib
packages.note: Compiled by //third_party/.src/zlib:zlib.

packages.name: libpng
packages.note: Compiled by //third_party/.src/libpng:libpng.

packages.name: libjpeg_turbo
packages.note: Compiled by //third_party/.src/libjpeg_turbo:libjpeg.

packages.name: modp_b64
packages.note: Compiled by //third_party/.src/modp_b64:modp_b64.

packages.name: wtl
packages.note: Header-only WTL under third_party/.src/wtl/include.

packages.name: yasm
packages.note: Assembler sources kept with the tree. Not a CMake install.

packages.name: jstemplate
packages.note: In-tree JS template helper.

packages.name: iaccessible2
packages.note: IAccessible2 headers/IDL snapshot.

packages.name: gtest
packages.note: Chromium gtest snapshot. testing/gtest junctions here. Label //testing:gtest.

packages.name: gmock
packages.note: Chromium gmock snapshot. testing/gmock junctions here.

packages.name: maplibre-native
packages.note: Copied pin from smartgis (tag ios-v6.30.0, commit 0ffe6336b4e7266c75c13337b4aa1d0f2b0877d5). If third_party/.src/maplibre-native already exists as a junction to the smartgis checkout, fetch reuses it. Not compiled by this repo's GN. Example: third_party/maplibre/example. Product DLL is mview_map.dll later.

packages.name: vtk
packages.note: VTK 9.5.2, /MD, Qt and Rendering groups off. No QVTK. Not in the views GN graph. Example: third_party/vtk/example. Future product consumer is mview_volume.dll.

packages.name: cesium-native
packages.note: cesium-native v0.64.0. Sources in third_party/.src/cesium-native, CMake install prefix third_party/.install. ezvcpkg fetches its own third-party deps during configure. The product globe still uses the copy inside Cesium for Unreal; do not also link this tree into mview_shell.

packages.name: cesium-unreal
packages.note: Cesium for Unreal 2.30 source plugin for UE 5.6 (CesiumForUnreal-56). Lands in third_party/.src/cesium-unreal. Shipped binary package name is CesiumForUnreal-56-v2.30.0.zip. Example: third_party/cesium-unreal/example. UE builds the plugin; this repo's ninja does not.

packages.name: unreal
packages.note: Unreal Engine 5.6 stays in the Epic install (or a licensed source tree) pointed at by UE_5_6_ROOT. Not cloned into third_party/.src. Example: third_party/unreal/example.

packages.name: glog
packages.note: Reused mogu pin (v0.6.0). Gitea already has this tag; not re-uploaded. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: googletest
packages.note: Reused mogu pin (v1.14.0). Gitea already has this tag; not re-uploaded. gtest_force_shared_crt=ON for mgis MSVC /MD. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: benchmark
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import of vendored googlebenchmark (not mogu benchmark v1.8.3; that Gitea repo is empty). Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: asio
packages.note: Standalone header-only ASIO (ASIO_STANDALONE). Gitea ccl/asio exists; GitHub fallback if the tag is missing. Do not add Boost.Asio. Used by src/net. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: cpp-httplib
packages.note: Header-only HTTP(S) client/server. HTTPS needs CPPHTTPLIB_OPENSSL_SUPPORT + //third_party:openssl (sync_openssl_win.ps1). Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: openssl
packages.note: Not fetched from git. Windows: winget install ShiningLight.OpenSSL.Dev then powershell -File third_party/tools/sync_openssl_win.ps1 → third_party/.install (and out/third_party junction). GN label //third_party:openssl. OpenSSL 3+ required by cpp-httplib. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: sqlite3
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: geos
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. LGPL — WKT display only. CMAKE_DEBUG_POSTFIX=d so Debug geosd.dll/geos_cd.dll can sit next to Release geos.dll/geos_c.dll in the same .install prefix (same coexistence as gdald.dll). Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: PROJ
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: SQLiteCpp
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: libspatialindex
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Dead product link — keep for third_party_all. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: gdal
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Frozen display adapter. GPKG needs SQLite3 (explicitly enabled below). Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: libspatialite
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Dead product link — keep for third_party_all. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: SpatiaLiteCpp
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: CxImage
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Compiled by thin //third_party/CxImage GN from .src/CxImage, not install.py. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: wtl8.0
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Header-only WTL in .src/wtl8.0. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: flycube
packages.note: Mirrored to Gitea from local FlyCube checkout (was shallow; unshallowed then pushed). Low-level DX12/Vulkan/Metal API behind render::rhi. Sources in .src/flycube; Release /MD libs merge into third_party/.install/lib (no flycube_prebuilt root). Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: assimp
packages.note: Gitea 404 as of 2026-09-13. Pin v5.4.3. Junction a local tree to .src/assimp (Importer.hpp). Do not GitHub-fetch from product TUs; Assimp stays off until that include exists. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: tinygltf
packages.note: Gitea 404 as of 2026-09-13. Pin v2.9.3. GitHub tag archive extracted to .src/tinygltf (tiny_gltf.h). Used only for 3D Tiles content, never as a tileset. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: khronos_gl
packages.note: Khronos OpenGL extension headers (MIT). Sources in .src/khronos_gl; thin GN at third_party/khronos_gl. Uploaded to Gitea (SHA e40d74db…). Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: ed25519
packages.note: tweetnacl/ed25519 used by src/base. Sources in .src/ed25519; thin GN at third_party/ed25519. Uploaded to Gitea. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: antlr4
packages.note: Runtime-only ANTLR 4.13.2 C++ (BSD-3). Gitea ccl/antlr4 exists but is empty; official source zip. Do not vendor the Java tool jar in the product DLL. GN //third_party/antlr4:antlr4_runtime. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: eigen
packages.note: Header-only Eigen 3.4.0 (MPL2). SparseLU backend for orthogrid Laplace / elliptic grid generation only — not geo Vector types. Reused existing Gitea mirror; not re-uploaded. No cmake install. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: octree
packages.note: jbehley/octree unibn Octree.hpp MIT header-only. Sources in .src/octree; thin GN at third_party/octree. Used by legacy/render/scene3d/index adapter only. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: CLI11
packages.note: CLIUtils/CLI11 header-only command-line parser (BSD-3). Sources in .src/CLI11; thin GN at third_party/CLI11. Used by SmartGisViews process entry. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: rapidjson
packages.note: Tencent/rapidjson header-only (MIT). Product JSON parse/write only — no homemade json_mini. Sources in .src/rapidjson; thin GN //third_party/rapidjson. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: concurrentqueue
packages.note: moodycamel concurrentqueue header-only (BSD). Sources in .src/concurrentqueue; include layout third_party/concurrentqueue/include/concurrentqueue/moodycamel/. Thin GN //third_party:concurrentqueue. Used by base/concurrency/queue.h PushOnlyQueue. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: vir-simd
packages.note: mattkretz/vir-simd header-only (LGPL-3.0-or-later). Portable Parallelism TS / C++26 std::simd (P1928) polyfill as vir::stdx::simd until MSVC ships <simd>. Sources in .src/vir-simd; thin GN //third_party:vir_simd. Product include via base/simd/stdx.h. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: pugixml
packages.note: zeux/pugixml (MIT). Replaces vendored TinyXML under src/legacy/xml. Sources in .src/pugixml; thin GN //third_party/pugixml compiles src/pugixml.cpp. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: yoga
packages.note: facebook/yoga W3C Flexbox (MIT). Sources in .src/yoga; thin GN //third_party/yoga compiles yoga/*.cpp for Views MarkupLayout. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: protobuf
packages.note: Official protobuf C++ (BSD-3). Policy allows product + future IPC; this pin is opt-in (skip_fetch_all). Enable fetch + cmake install when MVT or a proto consumer lands. Thin GN //third_party/protobuf when .install headers exist. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: curl
packages.note: libcurl 8.10.1 (curl license). Required by PDAL arbiter (cmake/curl.cmake is unconditional). Windows uses Schannel — no OpenSSL dep. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: libtiff
packages.note: libtiff 4.6.0 (BSD-like). Required by libgeotiff / PDAL GeoTIFF. GitLab archive (GitHub tag tarballs 404). Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: libgeotiff
packages.note: OSGeo libgeotiff 1.7.3 (X/MIT). PDAL requires standalone GeoTIFF. FindTIFF CONFIG yields TIFF::tiff whose VS include can resolve to lib/cmake/tiff/include (install.py junctions that to prefix/include after libtiff). TIFF_LIBRARY uses @D@ (tiffd.lib Debug / tiff.lib Release). Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

packages.name: pdal
packages.note: PDAL 2.8.3 (BSD). Point-cloud processing only (world3d.pdal_*). Default load_point_cloud stays LASzip. Needs zlib+libtiff+libgeotiff+curl (arbiter always links CURL). GEOTIFF/CURL libs use @D@ / @DASH_D@ (Debug: geotiff_d_i.lib + libcurl-d_imp.lib; Release: geotiff_i.lib + libcurl_imp.lib). CMAKE_DEBUG_POSTFIX=d so pdalcppd.dll can sit next to Release pdalcpp.dll. Install: build.bat release t pdal → .install; GN smt_has_pdal when include/pdal/PipelineManager.hpp exists. Gitea ccl/PDAL is 404 — GitHub fallback. Synced from smartgis for on-demand use in mview. Default product GN graph does not link this.

gitea_mirror.note: Same org Gitea as mogu/mgis. Existing mirrors are reused; do not re-upload. Override with GITEA_MIRROR_BASE / GITEA_TOKEN if wiring authenticated create/push.
